summary: Cofound mobile app full backend + frontend verification. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass (100%). Frontend: full e2e flow on mobile viewport (390x844) — login → matches list → connect (transitions to 'Request sent') → tab nav (matches/rooms/mentor/profile) → rooms list (8 seeded) → mentor (5/5 quota + 3 starter prompts visible) → profile (Aarav Mehta shown with skills/interests) → sign-out → re-login → tab nav back to matches. Mentor LLM end-to-end call returned a non-empty Claude Sonnet 4.5 reply and decremented quota. All critical user flows working.

issues: 'Join' touchables on each room row lack a stable testID (e.g. room-join-<id>) — UI works but is harder to assert in automation. Optional improvement.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Cosmetic only — comes from upstream RN/Expo libs.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID="room-join-<room_id>" to the Join touchable on each room card in (tabs)/rooms.tsx for cleaner automation.

(Optional, hygiene) Consider clearing TEST_*@cofound-test.com users from the DB periodically. They are created by the backend test suite and currently show up as extra matches (because they are onboarded during connect/chat tests). They do not affect production-style behavior; just visual noise on the matches list during demos.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~810 lines — still single-file but each section is cleanly delineated. Acceptable for now; consider splitting when adding more features (auth, chat, mentor, rooms could each be its own module).
Email is normalized to lower-case on signup/login (good). Tests must match that behavior.
EmailStr (pydantic) rejects reserved TLDs like .test/.example/.invalid — initial test emails using '@cofound.test' returned 422. Switched to '@cofound-test.com' in the test suite.
_current_user supports both JWT (email/password) and stored session_token (Google) — good unified path; expireAfterSeconds TTL on user_sessions auto-cleans expired Google sessions.

Mentor history replay: `for h in prior: ... await chat.send_message(UserMessage(text=h['content'])) if h['role'] == 'user' else None` — this actually re-sends every prior user message to Claude on every new turn, costing tokens/latency. Functional, but inefficient. Consider rewriting to construct prior context via system/assistant turns only, or rely on emergentintegrations' built-in session memory.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create disposable users with TEST_*@cofound-test.com (signup + onboarding). They are isolated to the API integration tests; no production seed data was modified. Seeded 14 demo users (already in startup_event) and 8 rooms verified intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://build-mobile-139.preview.emergentagent.com (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). All flows are covered by /app/backend/tests/test_cofound_api.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/ -v`. Demo user creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (aarav@cofound.demo / demo1234). Tab testIDs use the pattern bottom-tab-<matches|rooms|mentor|profile>. Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test/.example/.invalid TLDs — always use real-looking TLDs (e.g. .com) when creating test emails.
rca_of_issue: No product bugs found. Two early test failures were test-script issues (resolved): (1) Pydantic EmailStr rejected emails on the .test TLD → switched test emails to @cofound-test.com. (2) Session-scoped fresh_signup fixture became onboarded by an earlier test, causing 'matches empty for unonboarded' to fail → switched to function-local fresh user. After fixes, 21/21 pytest cases and all 7 frontend flows pass.
